Wait time after boot before the first app starts

This app weighs less than a photo. Support its development on Liberapay.

What does the app do?
After every boot it starts the selected apps one after another, with a delay, so the phone can settle first.

Setup
1. "Overlay": allow "Display over other apps". Without it Android does not let apps be started from the background.
2. "Battery": turn off battery optimization.
3. Tap apps in the lower list to select them. Hold and drag in the upper list to change the order.
4. "Start" = wait time after boot, "Gap" = pause between apps.
5. "Test" runs the sequence right away (without the start delay).

Xiaomi / HyperOS
Also allow "Autostart" for BootDelay in the system app settings.

Save / load
The icons at the top store the app list and times in a file and restore them, e.g. on a new phone.
